correctness.rationale: The proof establishes a unique global tangent slope in the first negative-cosine lobe for all even degrees, checks every later lobe by strict denominator comparison, and gives a sign-definite Chebyshev witness with exactly two contacts on the candidate support arc. Integration over arbitrary positive Borel measures forces the two contact fibers; the first moment fixes positive fiber weights and opposite nonzero k-th sine signs exclude asymmetric lifts. A simple-root expansion proves G_k=pi-2a*/k+O(k^-3). The standalone CHECK.py was executed from the actual package path with 104522 passing numerical diagnostic assertions; mesh checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp support-hole classification and equality rigidity for an entire infinite natural family of sparse Fourier moment constraints, not one ad hoc finite example. It resolves the sixth and every higher even notch, determines a universal high-frequency gap limit and cubic-order correction, and gives exact positive quadrature extremizers of bounded four-atom support. These precise invariants characterize the geometry of positive circular measures under minimal spectral constraints; the new global domination argument is not merely parameter substitution into the isolated k=4 formula.
